
DESCRIPTION
Start local development

USAGE
  one dev [projects...] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one dev
  one dev web
  one dev web api
  one dev --select

TIPS
Start all developable projects, or the selected project names or paths, in parallel. One task keeps its native terminal; multiple tasks use the TUI. Pipes and CI use streaming logs. Dependencies are prepared before startup. For pnpm, local development synchronizes the lockfile when needed and reuses an up-to-date installation.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --dry-run                Print the development command without starting it
  --env <value>            One project environment name
  --keep-going             Keep other projects running when a project exits
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  --select                 Interactively search and select projects to start
  --ui <value>             Terminal interface: auto | raw | tui | stream

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  -p, --project <value>    Legacy project selector (prefer the positional project)
